title: Customer Service Advisor - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Retail Support Administrator
description:
Age UK is recruiting! We have a fantastic opportunity to join our Retail Support team as an Administrator.
Working within our dedicated Retail Support Team, the successful applicant will utilise their skills in administration, data management and customer service to help ensure Age UK's retail Operations are compliant and well-supported.
Working full-time at our Warrington office, you will support our Retail Support Senior Co-ordinator in the swift response to both internal and external stakeholders, both over the phone and via email, while fostering positive relationships with shops, volunteers and external contacts.
With an average of around 4,000 retail volunteers supporting our shops and over £2 million generated annually through Gift Aid, you will take responsibility for any administrative duties through our new online volunteer application platform as well as ensuring the accurate compliance and administration of Gift Aid across Age UK's retail estate; experience and knowledge of Gift Aid is therefore fundamental to the role.
If you are a motivated Administrator looking to use your skills to support a charity that provides vital services and support to older people, then this may be the role for you!

Must haves:

Experience
Experience working within a high volume multi-functional administration role. A, I
Experience and knowledge of Gift Aid scheme. A, I
Experience at an advanced level of using Excel including V-look ups and formulas. A, I

Skills and Knowledge
The ability to prioritise your own workload. I
Proficient in the use of MS office applications including, Word, Outlook and Teams. A, I

Personal Attributes
An ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team. I
The ability to train on bespoke systems tailored to unique organisational requirements. I

Great to Haves:
The below competencies will be assessed at the indicated stage of the recruitment process: Application = A, Interview = I, Test = T, Presentation = P

Experience
Business administration qualification. A

What we offer in return
- Competitive salary, 26 days annual leave + bank holidays + annual leave purchase scheme
- Excellent pension scheme, life assurance, Health cashback plan and EAP
- Car Benefit Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme and Season Ticket Loan
- Techscheme - buy any tech from Apple or Currys, up to £1000, and spread the cost over 12 months, interest free
- Blue Light Card Scheme
- You Did It Awards - recognition awards from £100-250
- Many additional benefits

Additional Information

Supporting statements and anonymisation
Candidates are expected to provide a supporting statement that explains how they meet the competencies annotated with an 'A' in the job description, to assess suitability for the position. Age UK acknowledges and accepts that AI may be used to support the application; we do expect candidates to personalise experience, knowledge and skills and failure to do so, may result in your application being rejected.

Please submit a Word version of your CV as it will be anonymised by our recruitment system when you apply for a role. Our system is unable to anonymise supporting statements and heavily formatted CVs. Please could you remove any personal information including your name before you upload to support our inclusive recruitment process. All equalities monitoring information is also anonymised and not shared with the hiring panel. Your name and address will only be known to us if invited for interview.

Equal opportunities & Disability Confident Scheme
Age UK is an Equal Opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates, regardless of age, sex, race, disability, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital/civil partnership status, or pregnancy and maternity. Age UK is a Disability Confident Scheme employer. Due to high numbers of applications received, Age UK reserves the right to limit the overall number of interviews offered, and therefore, it may not always be practicable or appropriate to interview all disabled people that meet the minimum criteria for the job.

Reasonable adjustments
Disabled job seekers can access reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. All requests for reasonable adjustments are considered on a case-by-case basis, in collaboration with the disabled job seeker to best meet their needs, by contacting the Recruitment Team. Disability disclosures will be kept confidential and only shared on a need-to-know basis to support the implementation of adjustments. Disclosures will not be used to inform hiring decisions.

Age UK is committed to safeguarding adults at risk, and children, from abuse and neglect. We expect everyone who works with us to share this commitment.

Early application is encouraged as we will review applications throughout the advertising period and reserve the right to close the advert at any time.

Age UK politely requests no contact from recruitment agencies or media sales. We do not accept speculative CVs from recruitment agencies nor accept the fees associated with them.

For a full list of benefits please click here

title: Graduate HR Administrator
company: ARBORVITAE CARE SERVICES LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you a recent graduate looking to build a rewarding career in Human Resources? We are seeking a motivated and organised Graduate HR Administrator to join our growing HR team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about people, keen to develop their HR knowledge, and looking to gain hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle within a supportive and professional environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support to the HR team across all HR activities.
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases.
- Assist with recruitment processes, including advertising vacancies, screening applications, and coordinating interviews.
- Support onboarding and induction activities for new starters.
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters, and HR documentation.
- Assist with payroll administration and employee benefits processes.
- Monitor absence records and support leave management procedures.
- Respond to employee queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Ensure HR records remain compliant with company policies and employment legislation.
- Support HR projects, employee engagement initiatives, and training activities.

About You

We are looking for someone who:
- Holds a degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related subject (or is due to graduate soon).
- Has excellent organisational and administrative skills.
- Possesses strong written and verbal communication abilities.
- Is proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
- Demonstrates strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Can manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
- Maintains confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
- Is enthusiastic, proactive, and eager to learn.

Desirable
- Previous administrative, customer service, or internship experience.
- Knowledge of HR processes or employment law.
- Interest in studying towards a CIPD qualification.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Full training and development support.
- Opportunity to work towards a CIPD qualification.
- Career progression within a growing HR function.
- Friendly and collaborative working environment.
- Hybrid/flexible working options.
- Generous holiday allowance and company benefits.

How to Apply

If you're ready to take the first step in your HR career and develop your skills within a supportive organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV and a brief cover letter outlining why you're interested in the role.

title: 6 month FTC Administrator
description:
6 month FTC Administrator Warrington 27,000 - 28,000 DOE

Contract: Fixed-term contract until March 2027
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm (30-minute lunch)

We are currently recruiting for an Administrator to join a successful and established organisation based in Warrington, on a fixed-term contract until March 2027. This is a varied role, making it an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a busy, varied working environment.

The Role

Working as part of the team, you will be responsible for ensuring customer orders are processed accurately and efficiently, while also supporting the finance function with a range of administrative duties.
- Process customer orders on a daily basis.
- Work with customer-specific portals for both B2 B and D2 C orders.
- Use 3 PL warehouse portals to monitor orders and stock levels.
- Check order requirements against available stock.
- Process and update B2 B customer back orders.
- Complete sales invoicing.
- Provide customer stock updates.
- Respond to trade customer queries via email, with occasional telephone contact.
- Produce weekly sales reports for the Sales Team.
- Arrange faulty goods collections with the 3 PL provider.
- Process sales credit notes for returns and price corrections across B2 B and D2 C customers.
- Record goods receipts.
- Enter purchase invoices onto Sage.
- Raise purchase credit notes for faulty or undelivered goods from Head Office.
- Assist the Finance Manager with sustainability and other Excel reports.
- Send customer statements as required.
- Order office stationery when needed.
- Action debit note queries with B2 B customers.

You will ideally have:
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Strong communication and liaison skills, with a friendly but assertive approach.
- Previous experience using Sage ERP or a similar system.
- Excellent Excel skills.
- Good general IT skills, with previous experience using Microsoft Teams, Outlook and Word.
- The ability to multitask and manage a varied workload.
- A flexible approach and willingness to take on a wide range of responsibilities.
- Good written and numerical skills.
- The confidence to communicate professionally with customers, colleagues and external partners.

If you're an experienced administrator looking for a varied role where no two days are quite the same, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Accounts Assistant
description:

title: Reception/administrator
description: We are looking for a friendly, organised and motivated Receptionist and Administrator Document Workflow to join our team. This is an important role within the practice, providing an efficient and welcoming reception service while supporting the smooth and accurate processing of clinical and administrative documents. The successful candidate will be confident communicating with patients, colleagues and healthcare professionals, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage a busy and varied workload. You will be responsible for handling incoming correspondence, processing and allocating documents appropriately, maintaining accurate records and ensuring information is dealt with promptly and confidentially. You will also provide day-to-day administrative and reception support, helping to ensure patients receive a professional and positive experience. We are looking for someone who is reliable, approachable and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team. If you are organised, conscientious and enjoy working in a patient-focused environment, we would welcome your application. Provide a friendly, professional and efficient reception service to patients and visitors. Manage incoming telephone calls, enquiries and patient requests appropriately. Process, scan, read, code and workflow incoming clinical and administrative documents. Ensure correspondence is accurately directed to the appropriate clinician or team for action. Maintain accurate and confidential patient records in accordance with NHS policies and procedures. Provide general administrative support to the practice team. Liaise with clinicians, patients and external organisations as required. Prioritise and manage workload effectively, ensuring tasks are completed within required timescales. Follow information governance, confidentiality, safeguarding and health and safety procedures. Work collaboratively with colleagues to support the smooth and effective running of the service. Provide a welcoming, professional and courteous reception service to patients, visitors and healthcare professionals. Deal with face-to-face, telephone and electronic enquiries in an appropriate and timely manner. Process incoming clinical correspondence, letters, reports, referrals and other documentation. Scan, upload, accurately identify and allocate documents to the appropriate patient record and clinician/team.
